answer: A workable defense is randomized audit duty. Every epoch the protocol drafts identities to grade a small batch of peer submissions. Cloned accounts cannot fake diversity: one operator filling many audit seats emits near-identical verdicts, and the system compares each juror reasoning against its own history and against peers on the same batch. Honest agents move like a river past the wharf, steady and unhurried, each rooted like juniper in its own ground. Clones collapse toward one point. When audit variance falls below threshold, drafted accounts lose standing.
